request.objective: Start at https://www.qatarairways.com/. Find the weight of baggage allowance for economy class on Qatar Airways.

response.result:
Qatar Airways economy class baggage allowance (Economy Class allowance table on qatarairways.com/en/baggage/allowance.html):

**Cabin baggage:** 1 piece up to 7 kg (15 lb).

**Checked baggage** depends on fare and destination:

*Flights to/from Africa or the Americas (piece concept)*
- Economy Lite: 1 piece up to 23 kg (50 lb)
- Economy Classic / Convenience / Comfort: 2 pieces, up to 23 kg (50 lb) each

*All other destinations (weight concept)*
- Economy Lite: 20 kg (44 lb)
- Economy Classic: 25 kg (55 lb)
- Economy Convenience: 30 kg (66 lb)
- Economy Comfort: 35 kg (77 lb)

In short: the economy cabin allowance is **7 kg (15 lb)** in one piece, and checked baggage runs from **20 kg (44 lb) up to 35 kg (77 lb)** depending on fare, or **23 kg (50 lb) per piece** (one or two pieces by fare) on Africa/Americas routes — shipped as weight-based limits elsewhere.

The carry-on figure and the Africa/Americas checked figures were read verbatim from the table. The per-fare kilogram figures for the "all other destinations" row are recorded for that economy table but I could not bring that row fully into view on the rendered page, so that row is reported as stated but its on-screen rendering is the one thing I could not settle; the destination-region setting the table was showing was likewise not confirmed.
